usage: “奶茶” is a noun used to refer to milk tea, a popular drink in Hong Kong.
You can use “奶茶” as the subject or object in a sentence.
It can be used with measure words, like '杯' (cup) or '罐' (can).
When ordering, you can say '我要一杯奶茶' (I want a cup of milk tea).
It is commonly combined with adjectives to describe taste, like '好飲嘅奶茶' (delicious milk tea).
